title: A positive defect distribution avoids a signed fault-path model
statement: For commuting B_i=I-|p_i><p_i|, F_S=exp(theta sum_S B_i), centered local HP estimates give L*F_S<=C eta exp(a theta)|S|F_S, uniform over bath/reference. Actual replacement resets yield (log x_S)prime<=-k log x_S+C eta exp(a theta)|S|, k=kappa(1-exp(-theta))/theta. Choosing theta, then small noise/reset ratios and finite burn-in earns an incoming subset moment from arbitrary correlated states, provided those reservoirs/generators are supplied. This is scheduled source preparation, not a reset/clock hardware compiler.
